scope: Astra frozen-policy diagnostics and public GPT-6-Astra online manifests; not a controlled rerun

timing_definition.offline: Episode callback wall time minus measured neural initialization; simulator startup/reset and finalization excluded. Physics, rendering, observation, inference, planning, IPC and recording retained.
timing_definition.online: Sum top-level llm_calls[].latency_s once per unique call_index. API wait component only; no full rollout wall-time boundary is available in these manifests. No video duration proxy.

sampling: 14 previously successful offline configurations, five layout IDs 0–4 each, all outcomes retained. Task names and IDs align; scene assets, hardware, controller and outcome mix are not controlled.
online_total_wall_note: The 70 saved public manifests contain API latency and video frame timelines, but no complete rollout wall-time boundary.
